safe-drift.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original academic paper logo for a SIGNAL Lab website news card, displayed at about 340 by 255 pixels.
Primary request: create a polished, distinctive logo for the paper SAFE-DRIFT, which selects training examples for supervised fine-tuning to improve a target capability while controlling unwanted changes to other capabilities.
Composition: landscape 4:3 canvas. A strong, compact geometric symbol above the wordmark, centered with generous clean margins. Selected sample points on the left coalesce into one purposeful arrow pointing diagonally right, remaining inside a clean bounded oval or corridor that represents the allowable drift budget. The motif should read as controlled movement through selected data, with a small coral outlier point outside the boundary. Keep the central mark simple enough to recognize at small size.
Style: crisp flat vector-like academic identity; sophisticated minimal geometry, consistent substantial line weights, a visually balanced emblem. No photorealism, no gradients, no shadows.
Palette: rich teal #0F766E and deep navy #0F172A, supported by pale sage and a very small muted coral accent. Background: uniform opaque off-white #F7FBFA.
Text (verbatim): "SAFE-DRIFT". Bold clean modern sans-serif wordmark below the symbol, clear at small sizes. This is the only text.
Constraints: no generic lock or shield, no checkmarks or claim of guaranteed safety, no extra slogans or dates, no NeurIPS or university trademarks, no equations, no fake chart values, no watermarks. Produce a single finished logo, not a presentation board or multiple options.

connectomics.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original research-paper logo for a 4:3 news card on the SIGNAL Lab academic website.
Primary request: create a polished, distinctive, clean vector-like logo for a paper about graph convolutional networks applied to brain connectomes. The research investigates when graph convolutions help or fail under connectivity measurement error and the double use of noisy connectivity as graph and features; this is not a claim of guaranteed improvement.
Composition: a centered, elegant brain silhouette made from a sparse arrangement of round graph nodes and crisp connecting edges, with a small connectivity-matrix grid integrated into the lower part of the emblem. Two restrained signal paths, one orderly and one slightly irregular, subtly suggest structured signal and measurement noise. The emblem must be simple, bold, and legible at 340 by 255 pixels, not a dense scientific diagram.
Style: sophisticated flat geometric academic brand mark, consistent stroke widths, generous negative space, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no photorealism. Opaque very pale off-white background (#f7fbfa). Palette: teal #0f766e, deep navy #0f172a, pale sage, and a tiny muted coral accent. The image is a clean standalone logo composition, no card border or mockup.
Text: render only the exact wordmark "GCNs + CONNECTOMICS" in bold modern sans-serif below the emblem, perfectly spelled and horizontally centered; no other text.
Layout: landscape 4:3 canvas, full logo and wordmark comfortably within the central 75% of the canvas; ample clear margins on all sides. No cropped details.
Avoid: badges, checkmarks, shields, medical crosses, university or conference trademarks, fake quantitative results, busy waveforms, decorative filler, watermarks.
